mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real GDP signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations diminish.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances following a 3-month GDP decline, or if GDP declines do not precede significant negative returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are negatively impacted.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production index by more than 2% within the last month signals a supply-side shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as production slowdowns impact corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and real final sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 2% concurrently within the last month, it signals a strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and economic activity improve.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS increases > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not precede significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 1% signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances following a 3-month PAYEMS increase, or if PAYEMS increases do not precede significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the joint condition of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not precede significant negative returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 2% and real GDP (GDPC1) increases by more than 1% concurrently within the last quarter, it signals a strengthening supply-side and overall economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 2% and GDPC1 increases > 1% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the joint increase in INDPRO and GDPC1 does not precede significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05).
